method: (1) ecbench verify --replay-all on each of the three sessions with the binary whose SHA-256 equals every session's binary_sha256: every measured deterministic run re-executed and its counts compared with the record (warm-up runs are not replay candidates). (2) For every record, warm-ups included, the validator's own Python affine arithmetic on y^2 = x^3 + 7 over F_p (p, t, r parsed from the record's ICV1 string; b derived from G and required to be 7; p and r prime; r = p + 1 - t; rG = O) checks [d]G = Q for the recovered d and rejects [d+1]G = Q (negative control). No code shared with ecbench.
host_caveat: Replayed on the same 4-vCPU VM class that produced the sessions (auditor env class ECBENV3h0a8f39be1123 vs session ECBENV3h019d40ac615e; host hardware not changed). This is an independent process and invocation, not another host class; AGENTS.md section 12 asks for another host class only for an ecbench vs_rho claim, which this result does not make.
